gary_2026_10_22_vibin_out_w_hartford_ai_.title: Vibin' Out w/ Hartford AI Collective
gary_2026_10_22_vibin_out_w_hartford_ai_.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_22_vibin_out_w_hartford_ai_.summary: Gary's Guide: Join us for our second community vibe coding event at the University of Hartford's Mortensen Library. Vibin' Out is a shared space to build with AI: vibe coding, code agents, automating a workflow, or just quietly working alongside other builders. Join us between 12 PM & 4 PM. You are welcome to join us for an hour or the whole time. It's also a place to build skills: Learn what's new in AI Write better prompts Swap ideas with people testing the same tools Share what worked, what didn't, & what you're trying next Come as you are: Bring a project Join someone else's Or sit, code, & find a new way to optimize your AI stack, all while you stay in flow A few volunteer mentors & AI practitioners will be around to answer questions along the way. No structure, no slides. Just builders vibing together in the real world. Parking & directions: https://images.lumacdn.com/uploads/ax/2656dec0-cdc9-4906-ab04-603cbd71ed12.pdf As always, food & drink, engaging conversation, & incredible company will all be provided! Please be advised: Unfortunately, space is very limited at these community events & we can not always accept everyone we would like to. If you are not accepted to this event, please keep applying! We appreciate your application tremendously & we are looking forward to seeing you at a future event very soon! The AI Collective is a global non-profit building the human layer for the AI era. We unite 200,000+ leaders, builders, & stakeholders across 100+ forums worldwide to democratize the frontier, build trust, & coordinate how society navigates the rapid acceleration of technological progress. All attendees & organizers at events affiliated with The AI Collective agree to our privacy policy & are subject to our code of conduct.

gary_2026_10_23_spooky_civic_ai_hackatho.summary: Gary's Guide: Demos are Sunday at Demo Day. RSVP for that separately: luma.com/3perce-pi2u Spooky Civic AI Hackathon: Build AI Tools for NYC Free. Open to everyone. No approval needed, just RSVP. Fri Oct 23 - Sat Oct 24, in person in NYC or on Zoom. Come solo & we'll help you find a team. Free food for in-person builders. Who can come? Anyone who wants to build something for New York City: engineers, product managers, designers, people who used to code, & people who never have. The best teams pair people who know a problem with people who can build the tech. Builders write the code & ship the tool. Problem-solvers (PMs, designers, policy & community folks) pick the problem, shape how people will use it, & lead the pitch. No team? No problem. Most people come solo. You can meet teammates at our Oct 14 & Oct 15 classes, or at Friday's kickoff. Pick a track The Existential Track: Climate & Sustainability. Heat, waste, food access, cleaner air. Urban Nightmares: Housing, Healthcare, Education & Justice. Tenant rights, benefits, school help, legal info in plain English. Ghost in the Machine: AI infrastructure & scaling. Build the parts under civic AI tools, like search, data, & agents that keep them running. Physical AI for Good: Build AI that moves, with robot arm kits on site. No robotics experience needed. You leave with a working prototype, a demo video, & a real project for your portfolio. Mentors will be on hand all weekend. Where: NYC venue announced soon. The Zoom link goes to everyone who RSVPs. Partners: Robot arm kits & on-site mentors from Viam. Food & builder API credits from Vonage. Costumes encouraged. In-person spots are limited, so RSVP now. Sponsorship inquiries: Partner with 3percentclub About Viam: Viam is a New York-based software platform for building, deploying, & managing robotics & AI in the physical world. Viam is supplying robot arm kits & on-site mentors for this hackathon. About Vonage: Vonage, part of Ericsson, builds communications APIs for voice, video, messaging, & verification that developers put into their apps. Vonage is providing food & builder API credits for this hackathon. About 3percentclub: 3percentclub is an NYC nonprofit that teaches free AI classes for underrepresented builders: engineers, career changers, product managers, designers, & people who have never coded. This event is open to everyone. Want to go deeper with AI? Apply to the free AI Architect Fellowship for weekly classes, mentorship, & a community to build with. gary_2026_10_23_ai_founders_operators_in.summary: Gary's Guide: Join us for an evening of conversation, connection, & startup legal education for founders, investors, & members of the startup ecosystem. 7:00-8:00 PM | Mocktail Hour Meet fellow founders, investors, & startup professionals over drinks in a relaxed setting. 8:00-8:45 PM | Legal AMA We'll have a dedicated legal educational session exclusively for you to ask the legal questions that have been on your mind. We'll break down topics such as startup law, fundraising, equity, founder relationships, intellectual property, hiring, contracts, & other common legal issues, while sharing practical insights through an interactive Q&A. Come with questions. The formal event ends at 9:00 PM, but the space will remain open until midnight. Feel free to stay, continue networking, collaborate with other attendees, or get some work done. Who this is for: Founders & startup executives Investors evaluating or supporting early-stage companies Operators & startup team members Advisors & service providers working with startups We kindly ask that everyone support the venue by purchasing at least one drink. More importantly, we hope you leave having made a few new connections along the way. About the Hosts "No unemployed brokies not building anything." TechBrig: TechBrig is an AI product design & development partner for early-stage startups & venture-backed companies. We help teams build & scale software, from MVP to growth. techbrig.co Book a call with the founder Ad Hoc Founders Counsel (Bagchi Law PC), a legal practice focused on founders & early-stage companies navigating growth, structure, & everyday legal roadblocks. founderscounsel.law Schedule a consultation Disclaimers: The legal presentation & AMA are intended for general educational discussion. Any information shared during the event is not legal advice & does not create an attorney-client relationship. Professional photography & videography will be taking place throughout the event. By attending, you acknowledge & consent to being photographed and/or recorded. Photos & videos may be used in event recaps, on social media, & in future promotional & marketing materials. By registering for this event, you consent to receiving future communications from the event organizers, including updates about upcoming events & related programming. You may opt out of these communications at any time.

gary_2026_10_25_spooky_civic_ai_hackatho.title: Spooky Civic AI Hackathon Demo Day
gary_2026_10_25_spooky_civic_ai_hackatho.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_25_spooky_civic_ai_hackatho.summary: Gary's Guide: Want to build? RSVP for the Build Weekend (Fri Oct 23 - Sat Oct 24): luma.com/onzzmytl Spooky Civic AI Hackathon: Demo Day Free. Open to everyone. No approval needed, just RSVP. Sun Oct 25, 2-5pm, in person in Midtown or on Zoom. You don't need to have built anything. Come watch, cheer, & meet people. What happens Teams show the AI tools they built in one weekend to help New York City, across 4 tracks: The Existential Track (climate), Urban Nightmares (housing, healthcare, education, justice), Ghost in the Machine (AI infrastructure), & Physical AI for Good (robots). Judges pick the winners, & we hand out prizes. Who should come? Anyone curious about AI or civic tech: friends of builders, people thinking about joining a future hackathon, nonprofit & city folks looking for new tools, & anyone who wants to see what's possible. Where: Midtown Manhattan. The exact address & the Zoom link go to everyone who RSVPs. Partners: Thank you to Viam & Vonage for making this weekend possible. Costumes encouraged. Sponsorship inquiries: Partner with 3percentclub About Viam: Viam is a New York-based software platform for building, deploying, & managing robotics & AI in the physical world. Viam is supplying robot arm kits & on-site mentors for this hackathon. About Vonage: Vonage, part of Ericsson, builds communications APIs for voice, video, messaging, & verification that developers put into their apps. Vonage is providing food & builder API credits for this hackathon. About 3percentclub: 3percentclub is an NYC nonprofit that teaches free AI classes for underrepresented builders: engineers, career changers, product managers, designers, & people who have never coded. This event is open to everyone. Want to go deeper with AI? Apply to the free AI Architect Fellowship for weekly classes, mentorship, & a community to build with. The AI Collective is a global non-profit building the human layer for the AI era. We unite 1,000,000+ leaders, builders, & stakeholders across 300+ forums worldwide to democratize the frontier, build trust, & coordinate how society navigates the rapid acceleration of technological progress. All attendees & organizers at events affiliated with The AI Collective agree to our privacy policy & are subject to our code of conduct.

gary_2026_10_26_monday_founders_coworkin.title: Monday Founders Coworking Pod
gary_2026_10_26_monday_founders_coworkin.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_10_26_monday_founders_coworkin.summary: Gary's Guide: If you're an early stage founder, building alone is hard. You lose momentum, get stuck with no one to ask, & there's no one checking if you actually did what you said you'd do this week. We're a small group of founders working together for the month - think study group, but for building. We help each other, check in, & keep each other on track. Now we're opening it up to more people, in pods of 3-5. Here's how it works: you tell your pod what you're trying to get done, & they hold you to it. Stuck on something? Someone in the pod probably knows the answer. Starting to slip? Someone notices. Same faces every week, so you're never starting over with strangers. This is an outgrowth of our Wednesday coworking events - just smaller. We're here to build the idea & building culture NYC deserves. We focus on that foundational layer of relationships & community that allows for ideas to spread & building to happen. Enough of the transactional networking. Product first, business second. Cohort is a community of founders, builders, creatives, & researchers in NYC, & the Monday pod is our small-group coworking ritual. Let's build. More from Cohort Keep building, exploring ideas, & meeting the community. Find your next gathering below. Explore & connect The Crawling Dead: Halloween Food Crawl Sat, Oct 31 A Halloween afternoon food walk through Brownstone Brooklyn, with local bites & spooky stoops. gary_2026_10_26_the_shortlist_founder_sh.title: The Shortlist Founder Showcase
gary_2026_10_26_the_shortlist_founder_sh.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_10_26_the_shortlist_founder_sh.summary: Gary's Guide: The Shortlist NYC - October Founder Showcase (#10) The Shortlist is back for our monthly Founder Showcase & the room keeps getting better. This is a monthly curated, application-only evening connecting early-stage founders with exceptional operators across New York. No panels. No pitches to VCs. Just six founders building breakout companies, a room full of people who've built things themselves, & the kind of candid conversation you don't get at most events. Each founder will share what they're building, why it matters, & the specific roles they're actively hiring for right now - followed by a mixer. What to expect: Founders presenting at the seed through Series B stage. Operators, builders, & executives who've seen what good looks like. An intentionally small room designed for real connection. Who this is for: Exceptional operators - whether you're actively exploring your next role, casually curious, or simply want to stay close to what's being built in NYC right now. Founders will be announced in the days leading up to the event. Attendance is intentionally limited. Apply to be considered. More information on The Shortlist can be found here. Founded by Andrew Yeung & Ivor Straford.

jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.title: Hamilton Park Farmers Market 2026
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.label: Festival / Market
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.place: Hamilton Park, 9 McWilliams Pl., Jersey City, NJ
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

jc_culture_42883_2026_11_18_jodeci_jerse.summary: Get ready to experience an unforgettable night as Jodeci takes the stage for their highly anticipated concert, “”Jodeci – Jersey City,”” at the iconic Landmark Loews Theatre. Nestled in the heart of Jersey City, this historic venue boasts a stunning atmosphere that perfectly complements the smooth R&B vibes of the legendary group. With its grand architecture and intimate setting, the Loews Theatre is the ideal backdrop for an evening filled with soulful melodies and nostalgic hits. Join fellow fans for a night of electrifying performances that will have you singing along and dancing in your seat. The energy will be palpable as Jodeci delivers their timeless classics and new favorites, making this a must-see event for R&B lovers. Don’t miss out on this chance to witness music history in the making—secure your spot now and be part of the magic at Jodeci – Jersey City!
